title: Sicilian: Accelerated Dragon
blurb: A Sicilian with far less theory than the Najdorf. The bishop on g7 does the work.

replies.idea: The Sicilian. Unbalance the position from move one.
Take — a wing pawn for a centre pawn.
Prepare the fianchetto. Saving a tempo over the normal Dragon is the whole point.
The bishop's diagonal is the soul of this opening.
